description: List editions of a work — different publishers, languages, formats, and print runs. Returns ISBNs, publisher, language, page count, and edition OLIDs. Use after openlibrary_get_work or openlibrary_search_books to find a specific printing. A merged work ID resolves to the work it was merged into. To reach a work from an ISBN, call openlibrary_get_edition with id_type "isbn" — its work_id output is the parent work.

limit.description: Max editions to return. Prefer 10–20 for exploration.

work_id.description: Open Library Work ID. Format: OL…W (e.g., "OL45804W"), optionally prefixed "/works/". Not an ISBN — resolve an ISBN to its work with openlibrary_get_edition (id_type "isbn").

name: openlibrary_get_editions

editions.description: Editions of the work, up to limit.

items.description: A single edition of the work.

edition_id.description: Open Library Edition ID (OL…M). Use for openlibrary_get_edition with id_type "olid".

page_count.description: Page count. Absent when not recorded.

publish_date.description: Publication date string (e.g., "2003", "January 2003"). Absent when not recorded.

title.description: Edition title (may differ from work title for translated editions).

work_id.description: Parent Work ID. Usually matches the top-level work_id.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Work ID does not exist on Open Library, or it redirects to no reachable work. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Set when the requested work ID was merged into a different canonical ID.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first returned result — echoes the requested offset, so an empty page still records the offset that produced it.

totalCount.description: Total editions for this work across all pages.

work_id.description: Canonical Open Library Work ID the editions were found under — differs from the requested work_id when that ID was merged into this work.

title: Get Editions
